tasks.name: הורד ראשון אם זוגי
tasks.note: Drops the first element only when it is even; otherwise returns the list unchanged.

tasks.name: בלי המקסימום
tasks.note: Removes the element equal to the list maximum, keeping the rest in order (empty stays empty).

tasks.name: קח כל עוד קטן מ-13
tasks.src: l=>{ const r=[]; for(const x of l){ if(x>=13) break; r.push(x); } return r; }
tasks.note: Take-while: keeps the leading run of elements below 13, stopping at the first element >= 13.

tasks.name: דלג על אי-זוגיים בהתחלה
tasks.src: l=>{ let i=0; while(i<l.length&&l[i]%2===1) i++; return l.slice(i); }
tasks.note: Drop-while: skips the leading run of odd elements and keeps everything from the first even one on.

tasks.name: הפוך אם ראשון גדול מאחרון
tasks.note: Global condition: reverses the list only if its first element is larger than its last, else unchanged.

tasks.name: מיין אם האורך אי-זוגי
tasks.note: Global condition: sorts ascending only when the list length is odd; even-length lists are returned unchanged.

tasks.name: קטנים מהאחרון
tasks.note: Keeps only elements smaller than the last element (the threshold comes from the list itself).

tasks.name: מהמקסימום והלאה
tasks.src: l=>{ if(!l.length) return []; const m=Math.max(...l); return l.slice(l.indexOf(m)); }
tasks.note: Drop-while not max: discards everything before the largest element and keeps the max and what follows.

tasks.name: שיאים מתחדשים
tasks.src: l=>{ const r=[]; let m=-1; for(const x of l){ if(x>m){ r.push(x); m=x; } } return r; }
tasks.note: Loop with a running decision: keeps each element that is larger than every element before it (prefix records).

tasks.name: רישא יורדת
tasks.src: l=>{ const r=[]; for(const x of l){ if(r.length&&x>r[r.length-1]) break; r.push(x); } return r; }
tasks.note: Take-while with a relative condition: keeps the longest decreasing prefix, stopping at the first rise.

tasks.name: זוגיות הפוכה לראשון
tasks.note: Keeps only elements whose parity differs from the first element's parity (so the first is always dropped).

tasks.name: הזוגיות של הרוב
tasks.src: l=>{ const e=l.filter(x=>x%2===0), o=l.filter(x=>x%2===1); return e.length>=o.length?e:o; }
tasks.note: Counts evens and odds, then keeps only the majority parity (evens on a tie), preserving order.
